subject: general
question: 'Freedom in Exile' is the autobiographical book of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dalai Lama**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Freedom of Exile is an autobiography of the 14th Dalai Lama.
 
• The 14th Dalai Lama also called Tenzin Gyatso.
 
• The 14th Dalai Lama won Nobel Peace Prize in 1989.
 
• The book Freedom of Exile acknowledges the cultural gaps between Tibetan Buddhists and the scientific approach of the west.
 
• In the book, he discusses the 1959 Chinese invasion of Tibet and the years he spent since then caring for his fellow Tibetan refugees.
